project_name: River Bend AI Data Center Campus
status_detail: LED announced on Dec. 17, 2025 that Hut 8 will develop the River Bend AI data center campus in West Feliciana Parish and that construction was already underway, with operations expected to commence in Q2 2027. Hut 8's project page lists 245 MW commercialized IT capacity supported by 330 MW utility capacity and potential expansion to up to 1,000 MW utility capacity.
notes: Phase I investment up to $10B; Fluidstack is anchor tenant with Google financial backstop per LED. WAFB reports location just off Highway 61 on LA 964 and parish documents related to the project. Capacity_mw records critical IT load; utility capacity is 330 MW with potential scale beyond/up to 1 GW.
